title: 马克斯2009年后：没真正糟糕过，所以人们外推顺境？
speaker: Howard Marks

segments.en: But I think there are certain underlying truths which are positive, which are in the ascendancy.
segments.zh: 但我认为有一些积极的底层事实正在占据上风。

segments.en: Our economy is doing pretty well in the aggregates. It is, in my opinion, the best performing developed world economy.
segments.zh: 我们的经济总体表现相当不错。在我看来，它是表现最好的发达经济体。

segments.en: So, the old Tina trade, there is no alternative. And there is the excitement over AI.
segments.zh: 所以，老一套的TINA逻辑——别无选择。再加上对AI的兴奋。

segments.en: And so the optimism is just coming from the quote. And the other thing is that, you know,
segments.zh: 所以乐观情绪就来自这些。另外还有一点，

segments.en: we haven't really had a really bad time since March of 2009 when the stock market bottomed during the global financial crisis.
segments.zh: 自2009年3月市场在全球金融压力中见底以来，我们还没有真正经历过非常糟糕的时期。

segments.en: And so people get used to good times and they extrapolate good times. And that contributes to the optimism.
segments.zh: 于是人们习惯了顺境，并把顺境外推。这助长了乐观情绪。
